descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Part-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii profesionale
L2 IT Support Engineer 
 Location: Bucharest, Romania 
 Work Arrangement: Onsite – Designated Support
 Schedule: Monday and Wednesday
 Key Responsibilities
Provide Level 2 technical support for hardware, software, and IT infrastructure issues.
Troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, peripherals, and operating system issues.
Diagnose and resolve network connectivity issues, including LAN, Wi-Fi, and VPN.
Install, configure, and maintain end-user devices and applications.
Manage user accounts, access permissions, and basic system configurations.
Log, update, and resolve incidents through the ticketing system.
Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate support teams.
Ensure timely resolution of incidents while maintaining a high level of customer service.
Coordinate with remote IT teams and follow established support procedures.
 Requirements
Previous experience in L2 IT Support, Desktop Support, or IT Infrastructure Support.
Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and networking.
Knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365.
Basic understanding of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN.
Experience with ticketing systems and incident management.
Good communication and customer service skills.
Ability to work independently and provide onsite technical support.
